libraryPreparationPreflight.agent_guidance: If generated tests exercise org.apache.kafka.common.security.kerberos.KerberosError or org.apache.kafka.common.network.SaslChannelBuilderTest (or similar SASL/Kerberos internals), mirror what kafka-clients:4.2.1's build.gradle does: add JVM arg --add-exports=java.security.jgss/sun.security.krb5=ALL-UNNAMED and system property junit.jupiter.extensions.autodetection.enabled=true to the Test task, and add the matching graalvmNative binaries.all buildArgs/runtimeArgs (--add-exports=... for buildArgs, -Djunit.jupiter.extensions.autodetection.enabled=true for runtimeArgs) so the same coverage works under Native Image. Not needed if no such tests are added.

deterministic_setup.reason: Needed if tests exercise Kafka's PEM-based SSL keystore/truststore path (DefaultSslEngineFactory); kafka-clients:4.2.1's coverage-improvement PR added the same dependency for equivalent SSL coverage.

risks: The bouncycastle dependency and env/JVM setup are only needed if the generated coverage actually touches SSL PEM stores or SASL/Kerberos internals; if coverage stays in other areas (serialization, admin client, protobuf-shaded utils, etc.) none of this applies and the extra dependency is simply unused.
Local Gradle/Native Image verification remains authoritative — confirm the actual generated tests before deciding these are needed.
libraryPreparationPreflight.summary: kafka-clients 4.2.0 has no SASL/Kerberos/SSL coverage yet; the sibling 4.2.1 coverage-improvement PR needed a bouncycastle dependency plus JVM/native-image export and system property to cover that area under Native Image.
